findings.title: Direct EncryptionClient.init({ strategy }) silently drops the custom auth strategy
findings.label: valid
findings.note: Same verified mechanism: the init() rename drops a legacy strategy key without warning, and the alias handling exists only in Encryption() at lines 864-867.

findings.title: Test-only latch reset becomes a published API on two entries
findings.label: trivial
findings.note: The test reset hook really is exported from the published ./encryption and ./wasm-inline subpaths, but as the finding admits it is only an API-hygiene issue with no data or security effect.
